title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Start as Small-Time Criminals Before Big Jobs
description: According to IGN Games, GTA 6 protagonists Jason and Lucia will begin their criminal careers as small-time criminals before tackling high-value jobs.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rising Through the Ranks: Jason and Lucia's Criminal Journey in GTA 6

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece continues to soar, new details have emerged regarding the criminal progression of its protagonists. According to a recent report by IGN Games, GTA 6 will feature a progression system where main characters Jason and Lucia start out as small-time criminals before they are able to work their way up to lucrative, high-value jobs.

### From Petty Crime to Major Heists

In many open-world crime titles, protagonists are often thrust into high-stakes operations almost immediately. However, Rockstar Games appears to be taking a more grounded approach with Jason and Lucia. By starting as small-time criminals, players will experience a more gradual accumulation of power, respect, and resources within the game's criminal underworld.

This progression structure allows players to deeply engage with the mechanics of the game from the ground floor. Working up to high-value jobs implies that players must earn their stripes, carefully planning and executing smaller offenses before gaining access to the massive, high-risk operations that the series is famous for.

### Enhancing the Open-World Experience

This deliberate pacing not only serves the narrative depth of Jason and Lucia's partnership but also enriches the overall gameplay loop. As the scale of the crimes grows, players will naturally master the game's systems, from evasion tactics to resource management, making the eventual high-value jobs all the more rewarding.

## Editor's Take

Having Jason and Lucia start as small-time criminals is a brilliant narrative and gameplay choice. It grounds the characters in a realistic criminal ecosystem and makes the eventual transition to high-value jobs feel genuinely earned, elevating both the story immersion and the overall player investment.
